description: Land Acquisition - Kandewatta, Galwadugoda, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Minister for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose, including detailed descriptions of the land lots, their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisitions and property matters, not government personnel changes or structural reforms.
